        self.fr.append(u);self.to.append(v);self.cap.append(capacity);self.cost.append(cost);self.rev.append(e+1);self.initial.append(capacity)
        self.fr.append(v);self.to.append(u);self.cap.append(0);self.cost.append(-cost);self.rev.append(e);self.initial.append(0)
        self.g[u].append(e);self.g[v].append(e+1)
        return e

def min_cost_circulation(graph, max_iters=100000000):
    n=graph.n;g=graph.g;to=graph.to;cap=graph.cap;cost=graph.cost;rev=graph.rev
    maxabs=max((abs(c) for c in cost), default=0)
    if maxabs==0:
        eps=1
    else:
        eps=maxabs
    price=[0]*n
    excess=[0]*n
    cur=[0]*n
    E=len(to)
    rounds=0
    while eps>=1:
        rounds+=1
        # saturate all negative reduced-cost residual arcs
        for e in range(E):
            c=cap[e]
            if c>0:
                u=graph.fr[e];v=to[e]
                if cost[e]+price[u]-price[v] < 0:
                    cap[e]=0
                    cap[rev[e]]+=c
                    excess[u]-=c
                    excess[v]+=c
        # active queue
        active=[]
        inq=[False]*n
        for i in range(n):
            if excess[i]>0:
                active.append(i);inq[i]=True
        # process
        for i in range(n):cur[i]=0
        pushes=0;relabels=0
        while active:
            u=active.pop();inq[u]=False
            if excess[u]<=0:continue
            gu=g[u]
            while excess[u]>0:
                i=cur[u]
                found=False
                while i<len(gu):
                    e=gu[i]
                    if cap[e]>0 and cost[e]+price[u]-price[to[e]]<0:
                        v=to[e]
                        d=excess[u]
                        if cap[e]<d:d=cap[e]
                        cap[e]-=d;cap[rev[e]]+=d
                        excess[u]-=d
                        old=excess[v];excess[v]+=d
                        if old<=0<excess[v] and not inq[v]:
                            active.append(v);inq[v]=True
                        pushes+=1
                        found=True
                        if excess[u]==0:break
                        # same edge if cap remains; loop continues with same i
                        continue
                    i+=1;cur[u]=i
                if excess[u]==0:break
                # relabel
                price[u]-=eps
                cur[u]=0
                relabels+=1
                if relabels>max_iters:
                    raise RuntimeError('too many relabels')
        # verify excess zero
        if any(excess):
            raise RuntimeError('nonzero excess')
        eps//=2
    return price,rounds

def solve_assignment(R,O,pairs,source=0,sink=1,base=2,costmax=10**9):
    # nodes source,sink,requests base.., offers base+R..
    n=base+R+O
    G=Graph(n)
    for i in range(R):G.add(source,base+i,1,0)
    for j in range(O):G.add(base+R+j,sink,1,0)
    cross=[]
    for i,j,c in pairs:
        cross.append(G.add(base+i,base+R+j,1,c))
    # T->S
    ts=G.add(sink,source,R,costmax+1)
    t=time.time();price,rounds=min_cost_circulation(G);dt=time.time()-t
    flow=[]
    for e in cross:
        f=G.initial[e]-G.cap[e]
        if f:flow.append((G.fr[e]-base,G.to[e]-base-R,f))
    # cost from original cross flows
    total=sum(c for _,_,c in [(0,0,c) for c in []] )
    return flow,dt,rounds
